description:
This is an Android application that uses the Pixabay API to browse, search, and download images.
Features:
• 🔍 Search images using keywords
• 🎨 Filter images by category and color
• ⬇️ Download images
• 🔄 Swipe to refresh content
• 🔍 Pinch-to-zoom on image previews
• 💾 Efficient image loading and caching
• 📱 Responsive UI
